name: omniscient/omnibase
description: omnibase: entities, view models, contracts and helpers on Doctrine and Twig; under Symfony with omnibridge/symfony

suggest.omnibridge/symfony: The core under Symfony (since 4.0; BaseBundle refuses to start without it): the adapters of the host's contracts over Symfony's services (Omnibridge\Symfony\*, since A1) and the framework packages the core no longer requires - FrameworkBundle, DoctrineBundle, SecurityBundle, TwigBundle, MonologBundle, twig/extra-bundle, Form, Routing, HttpKernel... A Symfony site requires it beside omniscient/omnibase, with the bundles below that its config/bundles.php registers; a Laravel site does not (omnibridge/laravel)
suggest.scheb/2fa: Two-factor sign-in (TOTP, e-mail codes, backup codes, trusted devices): installed, Base\Entity\User implements its Scheb\TwoFactorBundle\Model interfaces (Base\Contract\TwoFactorUser); register SchebTwoFactorBundle for the sign-in itself (^7.0|^8.0)
suggest.league/flysystem-bundle: The storages of the application's configuration (local, S3, SFTP...) behind the `flysystem` service every file, image and backup service reads; without it, omnibase's local storages (local.cache, local.uploads, local.wysiwyg and their .public) (^3.1)
suggest.hwi/oauth-bundle: Signing in through an identity provider (Google...): Base\Security\UserProvider is then the OAuth-aware provider (Base\Security\OAuthUserProvider) (^2.1)
suggest.web-auth/webauthn-symfony-bundle: Passkeys: Base\Repository\User\PasskeyRepository and Base\Security\WebauthnUserEntityRepository are its credential and user repositories (^5.3)
suggest.api-platform/symfony: The API of the #[ApiResource] entities (User, Thread); an App\ override replaces the Base\ resource it extends (^4.0)
suggest.api-platform/doctrine-orm: API Platform's Doctrine state for those resources (^4.0)
suggest.symfony/webpack-encore-bundle: The application's Encore build beside the core's (encore_entry_*_tags read both; without it, the core's alone) (^2.0)
suggest.symfony/ux-twig-component: The Base\ and App\ Twig components (^2.0|^3.0)
suggest.glitchr/ux-google: Google Analytics (AnalyticsSubscriber) and the reCAPTCHA of the sign-in and comment forms (1.0.*-dev)
suggest.nelmio/security-bundle: Security headers: CSP, clickjacking, external redirects (^3.0)
suggest.doctrine/doctrine-fixtures-bundle: demo:reset reloads the fixtures (the demo environment)
suggest.dompdf/dompdf: Base\Response\PdfResponse: an HTML page answered as a PDF (^3.0)
suggest.symfony/lock: demo:reset runs under a lock (the demo environment)
suggest.omniscient/omnishield: Base\Service\FormGuard's captcha, address lists and content classifier (the option `guard` of a form, Akismet behind SpamChecker): register Omnishield\Bridge\Symfony\OmnishieldBundle; not on Packagist yet - a vcs repository, https://github.com/glitchr-studio/omnishield
suggest.omnishield/altcha: ALTCHA, the default captcha of FormGuard: a proof of work served and checked by the site, no third party, no cookie, no consent
suggest.omnishield/disposable: Disposable e-mail domains refused at sign-up (base.guard.reputation)
suggest.omniscient/omnisign: Base\Service\Signatures: documents signed for any entity (Base\Entity\Signature\Envelope, mapped only with it), the signed file and its evidence kept in the private storage; register Omnisign\Bridge\Symfony\OmnisignBundle; not on Packagist yet - a vcs repository, https://github.com/glitchr-studio/omnisign
suggest.omnisign/docuseal: A DocuSeal instance of one's own: nothing leaves for a third party (omnisign/yousign, omnisign/docusign for the providers)
suggest.omniscient/omniauth: Signing in under any host (Symfony, Laravel, plain PHP): Base\Auth\ fills omniauth's stores on omnibase's tables (the accounts, user.password, the sign-in links of userToken hashed, the e-mailed codes hashed, the backup codes, the trusted devices' version, the identities of userIdentity), Base\Auth\Policy is SecurityPolicy on its second-factor rule, Base\Auth\Listener\* listen to its events; nothing is wired without it (1.x-dev)
suggest.omniauth/webauthn: Passkeys through omniauth: Base\Auth\UserPasskeys, the userPasskey table as omniauth/webauthn's records (formerly omniauth/passkey) (1.x-dev)
suggest.omniauth/otp: Authenticator applications through omniauth, on user.secret (Base\Auth\UserTotpSecrets), sealed at rest when omniauth.yaml sets totp.secret_key (formerly omniauth/totp) (1.x-dev)
suggest.omniauth/google: Google sign-in through omniauth, linked by its subject in userIdentity (Base\Auth\UserIdentities; Base\Auth\PolicyLinking: never by the address an account with a second factor or an administration role); the providers' mechanics are omniscient/omniauth's own (1.x-dev)

patches.why: A Process built without a timeout - the core's own, new Process([...]) in CacheClearTrait, IntegritySubscriber and WebpackTagRenderer, and any other - waits SYMFONY_PROCESS_TIMEOUT seconds (a site sets it to its PHP max execution time), 60 when it is not set: Process's default 60 becomes null, read from the environment in the constructor.
